verdict.rationale: Hatchet is a durable workflow engine, so safe workflow versioning during deploys is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers workflow versioning, pinning in-flight runs to their starting code version, or determinism guarantees across deploys. The closest items, such as hot-reloading workers in local dev and the founder noting that workflow execution paths are declared ahead of time, do not speak to rolling out new code while existing runs finish on the old version.
